Method of Attack: ransomware-as-a-service operation where core malware developers recruit affiliates to compromise corporate networks, steal unencrypted data, and encrypt devices
demanding ransom payments with revenue share between core developers and affiliates
Attack Vector: compromise of corporate networks via affiliates
Indicators of Compromise: REvil Tor payment page demanding $25 million ransom initially, doubled to $50 million after time limit expired
REvil data leak page containing stolen passports, company contact list, government identification cards, and immigration documents
